model: Flint LeanP1 three-writer S3 storage model

published.hardware: r8g.48xlarge, 192 physical Graviton4 cores, 1.5 TiB RAM, volume enlarged from 1 to 2 TB
published.engine: tlc-rs native compiled checker; the terminal log records this engine

properties: Original Spec, eight invariants, Prop_NoSilentRevert and Prop_DeleteSettles, CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE, unchanged for the large run and control.

comparison.hardware: Fresh r8g.48xlarge, Ubuntu 24.04, one thread per physical core, taskset 0-191, sequential fresh processes, 2 TiB gp3, 1450 GiB cgroup, swap disabled. Compilation and installation excluded, GNU time wall and peak process RSS.
comparison.build: Native rustc 1.99.0, cargo build --release --locked -p dive-cli with LTO=false and 16 codegen units
comparison.control: Use the authors’ runner3.sh substitutions on LeanP1Holds1p3b.cfg: Writers={A,B,C}, MaxMint=2, MaxUI=0, MaxBarriers=1, MaxRestarts=0, MaxSyncs=0, MaxCopies=1. Only those seven constants are rewritten.
comparison.tlc: java -Xmx640g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=192 -cp tla2tools.jar tlc2.TLC -workers 192 -fp 0 -seed 0 -metadir FRESH -config CFG LeanP1.tla

reclamation.scope: completed-level measured Store trigger; live frontier, permanent startup and names are retained; not a hard cap or total RSS bound

comparison.full_control_interpretation: The ordinary protected-main revision and the separate experimental retained-pool run agree on verdict, depth, both counts and the empty queue. The ordinary run used the author’s EC2 instance type and worker count and took 6.53 times the author’s compiled-checker wall time. The original TLC comparison on this same node is separate.

two_barrier_control.hardware: Dedicated c8g.48xlarge, 192 physical Graviton4 cores, Ubuntu 24.04, 192 workers, taskset 0-191. Sequential fresh processes. Heap for pinned TLC 96 GiB.
two_barrier_control.change: Increase only MaxBarriers=1 to MaxBarriers=2 in the authors’ small three-writer control. Keep all ten properties.

exact_storage.platform: EC2 c7g.2xlarge, 8 physical Graviton3 cores, 11 GiB Core budget.
exact_storage.command: dive check LeanP1.tla --config TwoBarriers.cfg --store exact --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --workers 8 --max-memory 11g --time-limit 3200s --output json

negative_control.damaged_witness: Set the final barriers value to 9. Independent replay rejects the final Next step at both worker counts.

full_native_worker_pool.host: EC2 c8g.48xlarge, 192 physical Graviton4 cores, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws. Author used memory-optimized r8g.48xlarge. Both have 192 physical Graviton4 cores.
full_native_worker_pool.runtime: Experiment with retained pool and compact canonical rows; terminal from same binary as wide worker comparison. Production scheduling is qualified separately.
full_native_worker_pool.command: taskset -c 0-191 wave-retained check LeanP1.tla --config LeanP1Size3L4W3.cfg --workers 192 --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 310g --time-limit 72000s --output json

store_reclamation.scope: completed-level measured Store trigger; live frontier, permanent startup and names are retained; not a hard cap or total RSS bound

full_native_worker_pool.interpretation: Same completed verdict and depth. The 10 distinct and 83,107,769 generated-count differences are unresolved. Phase counters cover completed parallel levels, leaving 10,916.66 seconds outside measured expansion and admission. The run made 26 completed-level Store collections. No attribution of the unaccounted interval to collection until independently timed.

compiled_witness_controls.host: Dedicated c8g.4xlarge (16 Graviton4 cores). a1 through a5 run at one worker; two at 16. Short diagnostic processes used separate cores during compiler setup. Timings include process startup.
compiled_witness_controls.config_recipe: Start with the large CFG, replace the four constants above only. All properties and all other constants stay as released. The disjoint guard tests use a2 and two. DuplicateGuard uses tiny.cfg.
compiled_witness_controls.build: Build formal/tlc-rs from the source revision above with the archived lean/formal/results/2026-10-06-ec2/scripts/levelwriter.patch (SHA256 a8919c78ed34ad433be2a1312ada2d13ab61a84f16e1343cf71b77fe0ca4dfc4). For each module/config compile using tlc-rs -codegen NEW -config CFG MODULE, then cargo build --release in NEW.

commands.core: dive check MODULE --config CFG --workers W --store fp --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 24g --time-limit 1300s --output json
commands.tlc: java -Xmx14g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=W -cp tla2tools.jar tlc2.TLC -workers W -fp 0 -seed 0 -metadir FRESH -config CFG MODULE
commands.diagnostics: python3 scripts/perf/scale/flint_counts.py LeanP1.tla NEW; compare MarkedFlint.tla across the compiled author and pinned TLC on a2; compare DisjointFlint.tla across all three; compare DuplicateGuard.tla on tiny.cfg. For these short diagnostics use one worker and 1 GiB JVM heap; the Core diagnostics use exact state storage.

compiled_witness_controls.finding: With all eight invariants and both step properties, the GCas guard has two enabled disjunct occurrences when GatewayIgnoresLease and holder = "none". The published compiler generates one successor for the boolean guard; Core and pinned TLC generate both occurrences. Every other reported action agrees on a2. Replacing the guard with a logically equivalent IF makes all three match. This changes witness multiplicity, not the successor state. The large three-writer differences remain separate observations. The disjoint guard also accounts for exactly 899,045 excess occurrences on the complete 48,353,470-state two-writer configuration.

exact_fingerprint_and_tlc.hardware: Dedicated r8g.8xlarge, 32 Graviton4 cores pinned 0–31. All six processes run serially. Limits 190 GiB Core and 96 GiB JVM heap.

config_changes.L4W2: Replace Writers={A,B,C} with {A,B} in the archived full configuration.
config_changes.L2W3: Change MaxMint and MaxBarriers from 3 to 2 in the archived full configuration.

exact_fingerprint_and_tlc.arguments: Same Core and TLC profiles, fp 0, seed 0, unchanged source and ten obligations. Core --store fp|exact --time-limit 3200s. TLC -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=32 -workers 32 with fresh metadir.

successful_guard_overlap.host: Dedicated r8g.48xlarge, us-west-2, 192 physical Graviton4 cores. Sequential runs on CPUs 0 to W-1. Zero swap, 1400 GiB service cap, Rust 1.99.0 release builds.
successful_guard_overlap.inputs: Full is the released three-writer configuration. Two changes only Writers from {A, B, C} to {A, B}. Both retain all configured checks.
successful_guard_overlap.method: On each successful GCas, increment a relaxed AtomicU64 exactly when GatewayIgnoresLease and holder = "none". The instrumented PrintT(TRUE) still returns TRUE. Read the counter after the compiled checker returns. The adjusted count uses that same traversal.
successful_guard_overlap.reproduce: From the pinned author revision and archived levelwriter.patch in compiled_witness_controls.build, generate WeightedFlint.tla with flint_overlap.py module. Run its evaluator stage on formal/tlc-rs/src/eval.rs into a new file, then replace the scratch evaluator with that file and build the author compiler. Generate the checker with -codegen NEW -config CFG WeightedFlint.tla. Run the main stage on NEW/src/main.rs into a new file, replace the generated scratch main with it, then cargo build --release in NEW. Compare the resulting digests below.
successful_guard_overlap.interpretation: The full instrumented checker independently visited three more distinct fingerprints and generated 30 more occurrences than the uninstrumented published run. Weighting its own 83,107,713 overlaps leaves seven distinct fingerprints and 26 generated occurrences between it and Core. The remaining differences have no established cause.

exact_column_admission.host: Dedicated EC2 r8g.48xlarge, Graviton4, us-west-2a. 192 physical cores, 1400 GiB memory cgroup, swap disabled. Each run uses a fresh process and metadata directory.
exact_column_admission.inputs: Same author checkout, released levelwriter.patch, module, configurations and property scope as successful_guard_overlap. Small uses the author small-control CFG. Two uses the two-writer CFG. Fault extends the small control with invariant ZeroBarriers == barriers = 0.
exact_column_admission.identity: A per-variable dictionary interns normalized finite mathematical values. A fresh bit position is allocated when its ordinal first needs it. Existing keys remain stable. Direct mode permits 63 bits; in split mode two 64-bit banks separately intern complete bank words with equality and two 32-bit IDs form the joint key. Invertible nonzero permutation preserves the seen set sentinel. Key assignments are process-local. VIEW, SYMMETRY, unevaluated values and exceeded capacities refuse. The source adapter disables checkpoint output by default and rejects explicit recovery or checkpoints before opening metadata. Its CLI preflight is outside the measured traversal.
exact_column_admission.fingerprint_audit: For every first exact admission retain the original compiler fingerprint (including its seen-set sentinel rule) and count repeated admissions. Masking to zero supplies a positive collision control. This measures shared keys; different traversals can also prune descendants.
exact_column_admission.validation: 1,024 unique rows and all revisits after domain growth in both layouts, sequence/function equality, lazy-value refusal, and direct width overflow. Every gate ran in a separate process where required. Restaged compiler sources compared with the measured variant.
reproduce: Apply the archived levelwriter.patch in compiled_witness_controls.build to the pinned author checkout. With the scripts/perf/scale directory as SCALE, run python3 $SCALE/flint_exact.py checker formal/tlc-rs NEW. Run cargo build --release --bin tlc-rs --example check_codes in NEW. Run target/release/examples/check_codes, FLINT_FACTORED_HALVES=1 target/release/examples/check_codes, then target/release/examples/check_codes overflow.

Run python3 $SCALE/flint_overlap.py module LeanP1.tla WeightedFlint.tla. Run NEW/target/release/tlc-rs -codegen GENERATED -config CFG WeightedFlint.tla. Use python3 $SCALE/flint_exact.py main GENERATED/src/main.rs GENERATED/src/counted.rs, replace the generated scratch main with counted.rs, and cargo build --release in GENERATED.

Run the generated binary with -workers N -checkpoint 0 -metadir FRESH -fpmem 200000 -queue-mem 150000 -config CFG WeightedFlint.tla. Leave layout unset for direct, use FLINT_FACTORED_HALVES=1 for split mode. The audit adds FLINT_AUDIT_FP_BITS=0 or 64 and used -fpmem 4000 -queue-mem 4000 on Small. Audit-disabled controls used the same column encoding without the secondary table.

For Fault, add ZeroBarriers == barriers = 0 to a copy of the weighted module named Fault, and INVARIANT ZeroBarriers to the small CFG. Generate and run the checker, saving stdout. Run python3 $SCALE/flint-exact/replay.py LeanP1.tla Small.cfg FAULT_STDOUT NEW_DIRECTORY --dive /path/to/dive. This independently checks the printed states against the uninstrumented relations and rejects both damaged controls.

preflight_controls.host: Dedicated EC2 c8g.xlarge, Graviton4, 4 workers, Rust 1.99.0. Final adapter staged from pinned pristine source with the archive patch applied.
preflight_controls.model: Mini: Init x=0; Next x′=1−x; invariant x=0 or x=1. Normal mode exhausted 2 distinct / 3 generated / depth 2. VIEW x and SYMMETRY Permutations({A,B}) each refused before Init, exit 12, zero discovered.
preflight_controls.recovery: Both -recover DIR and -checkpoint 1 -metadir DIR refused before the scratch metadata directory changed. A pre-existing marker was the only file before and after both invocations.

exact_column_admission.source_version: The original exact-column admission controls used the ordered dictionary at baseline_revision in exact_column_dictionary_comparison.

exact_column_dictionary_comparison.host: Dedicated c8g.16xlarge, 64 physical Graviton4 cores, us-west-2a. 115 GiB cgroup, no swap, pinned CPU affinity. Rust 1.99.0. Identical generated checkers and source inputs across arms.
exact_column_dictionary_comparison.profile: Separate 17 s two-writer baseline CPU profile at 79 Hz, 5,507 samples. Mathematical::cmp 10.40% exclusive, raw Value::cmp 6.30%, cache_hash 5.08%. In eight snapshots 56–61 of 65 threads waited in futex_do_wait. Does not isolate time blocked on any individual lock.
exact_column_dictionary_comparison.change: Select one of 256 per-column shards with a hash of the normalized mathematical value; compare complete values within the hash bucket. Hold the column-wide lock only for allocating a new ordinal and assigning its bits. Previously one lock protected a BTreeMap ordered by the whole mathematical value.
exact_column_dictionary_comparison.checks: 1,024 distinct rows with revisits, direct width overflow, lazy refusal, sequence/function equality; 16 concurrent threads supplied the same 4,096 rows in different orders and physical representations; all keys agreed. Each check ran in fresh direct and split processes as applicable. Both forced-zero audits counted 449,594 repeats. The independent validator accepted both four-state ZeroBarriers witnesses against the original relation and rejected the modified initial state and skipped step for each.
exact_column_dictionary_comparison.reproduce: Use exact_column_admission.reproduce with the baseline source revision for the ordered dictionary. Use -fpmem 20000 -queue-mem 10000, fresh metadata, 64 workers on two writers. The small forced-zero control uses 16 workers and the injected fault uses eight. Run the two-writer graph in the indicated order. Build the concurrency probe as an additional checker example and run both direct and split layouts.
